thread:
Mira (Sales): Rapidsample confirmed formal benchmark. They want a vendor-signed run showing sustained 1k QPS for 20m, p50 <120ms, p99 <450ms. They also require FIPS-capable KMS and a clear cost figure for procurement. Can eng scope runbook + cost band?

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifiers: are responses streamed or single-shot? Also confirm avg tokens in/out and whether model must be pinned to a quantized build. Streaming + tool-calls change batching strategy.

Mira (Sales): Mixed workload: 60% short completions (~50 tokens out), 40% streaming assistant (avg context ~800 tokens). They insist on FIPS/HSM for key unwraps and want to know if Dedicated suffices vs Private.

Noor (Perf Eng): For a 1k QPS mixed workload plan on a hybrid pool: streaming workers (batch=4, concurrency=6) + short-completion workers (batch=12, concurrency=16). Start estimate: 12-18 A100-equivalent GPUs for main run; run smoke to seed KV cache. Important: set KV TTL=15m and preseed with representative sessions to capture locality.

Noor (Perf Eng): Proposed run steps:
- Prep: exchange KMS endpoint + cert chain, confirm model artifact (fp16/q4), reserve fleet
- Smoke: 10m @ 200 QPS to warm caches & pre-warm key material
- Main: Poisson ramp 0->1k QPS over 6m, hold 20m, include two 30s 2x bursts
- Tear down: 2m ramp down + collect traces

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Load example (k6 style):
```bash
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 00:23:20 --rps 1000 --config profile_rapidsample.js \
  --env API_URL=https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat --env TOKEN=$TOKEN
```
profile_rapidsample.js implements 60/40 mix and simulates streaming chunk delays + occasional tool call latencies.

Olga (Security): For FIPS KMS we need vendor, endpoint, certs, and unwrap QPS. Cross-region unwraps add 70-150ms. If customer can provision a proxied local HSM or allow our temporary key-proxy for the run, we avoid cross-region hits. Also: SOC2 + HIPAA require minimal trace retention and PII redaction; customer must sign the tracing consent form.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Cost framing: infra-hours + run eng/ops SOW. Example calc: steady tokens/sec ~1000 * 50 = 50k -> ~60M tokens over 20m. Token cost is small; GPU-hours dominate. If we allocate 16 GPUs for ~2.5h => 40 GPU-hours. At internal rate $3.25/GPU-hr = $130 raw. With ops support, observability, HSM proxy work, typical one-off run SOW = $5k-$10k. If they take a 1-week Dedicated reservation we can credit run fees.

Noor (Perf Eng): Monitoring checklist: p50/p95/p99 (API & model RT), GPU util, host CPU, KV cache hit/evict, stream_chunk_delay, kms_unwrap_rt, downstream tool latency, 5xx rate. Alerts: p99>800ms >90s or 5xx>1% sustained 2m. Rollback: sustained p99>1.2s for 2m or GPU mem thrash. Recovery: shift traffic to short-completions pool, reduce batch sizes, or pause streaming workers.

Mira (Sales): Great. I need a 1-pager cost summary + the runbook so I can send to procurement. Also list lead times: network peering + cert exchange = ~5-7 business days; Private deployment = 2-3 weeks.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Will draft runbook + cost 1-pager. Expect draft by Thu EOD.

Noor (Perf Eng): I'll also run a quick FIPS KMS unwrap microbenchmark today and post numbers (proxy regional 20-40ms, cross-region 90-180ms).

Olga (Security): I'll share the KMS questionnaire and HIPAA/SOC2 trace requirements.

infra-bot: Job queued: run_proof_1781234567_rapidsample (owner: Jamal). Tentative window: 2025-04-02T14:00Z.

Mira (Sales): Thanks all. Once runbook + cost 1-pager in thread I'll schedule customer sync. :white_check_mark:
